visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a busy traditional market with stalls of fruit and red paper decorations. Two middle-aged women are engaged in a physical altercation; one in a red jacket and green scarf pushes another in a black and white patterned vest. A man in a blue hoodie and white baseball cap tries to separate them. Bright fluorescent lighting illuminates the cluttered background. (2) The camera cuts to a medium shot of a young man with styled dark hair, wearing a grey New Balance zip-up hoodie over a maroon shirt, standing in the same market environment. He holds a piece of fruit and gestures with his hands while smiling at the camera. (3) An interview takes place in the market. A woman in a patterned vest and a colorful silk scarf speaks enthusiastically into a yellow microphone, pointing off-camera. The background shows stacked produce and market patrons. (4) The young man from earlier is now outdoors, standing near a playground. He wears the same grey jacket. He lifts his leg to rest his foot on a red plastic structure, showcasing a black New Balance sneaker. The lighting is natural daylight. (5) A graphic overlay appears against a white background, displaying three colorways of the New Balance 740 series (Black, White, and Cream). Text and icons are arranged in a clean, commercial layout. (6) Back in the market, the young man presents shoeboxes to the two women from the initial argument. They are now smiling and laughing together. (7) A montage shows a young woman in a yellow hoodie and a man in grey trousers walking and posing outdoors, specifically highlighting their white New Balance sneakers. (8) The final scene is a group pose in the market featuring the young man, the market women, and a person dressed as a young girl in a yellow dress holding a large carrot.

The BGM shifts to a light, funky pop rhythm with a clear bassline. (3) The audio switches to field recording quality during an interview. High ambient chatter from the market is audible.
